description: 6 agents in parallel (best-of-6), each controlling eighteen robots on two floors and changing one route per answer; the best improving answer of each round is accepted. Stops at a safe plan with F1 <= 153 and F2 <= 156, after 5 rounds without improvement, or after 80 rounds.
stopping: 5 rounds without improvement (30 answers), both floors safe with F1<=153 and F2<=156, or 80 rounds
